description: Keyword search across the text of EDGAR documents filed since 2001 (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and their exhibits, proxies, S-1s...) through SEC EDGAR full-text search. Put a phrase in double quotes. Returns documents, best match first, each with its form, filing date, the companies on it (FinancialMD ids where covered) and links to the document and the filing index. Use it to find which companies mention a risk, customer, product or term; then read numbers with financials_standardized or the document with filing_document.

company.description: Optional: only this company's documents. Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 10, at most 100).

q.description: Words to find; a phrase in double quotes matches exactly. Letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation.

name: filing_search

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { total, items: [{ accession, form, file_type, filed, period_ending, companies: [{ cik, name, fmd_id, ticker }], document_url, index_url }], next_page, source }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Search filing text
